description: Descr::diff negated every axis of the subtrahend and then intersected, even where the minuend's axis is empty; an empty negation alone allocates a one-clause top list. Sites (census f4c8d266a): types/dnf.rs:84 (5,936), dnf.rs:61 (8,288), finite_set.rs:103 (1,808). Change: FiniteSet::diff, dnf_diff, Descr::diff_structure per axis; dnf_intersect_with returns early when either side is empty; neg_structure removed. Spike: 718,197 -> 705,444 on the OptionParser probe, output and canonical dump identical.
title: Subtracting from an empty axis negates nothing
